text.ms: Sekampit 10kg Beras Super Cap Rambutan berharga {price:2023-04} pada Apr 2023 dan {price:2024-04} pada Apr 2024. Bernas menaikkan harga beras putih import sebanyak 36% pada 1 September 2023.
text.en: A 10kg bag of Super Cap Rambutan rice cost {price:2023-04} in Apr 2023 and {price:2024-04} in Apr 2024. Bernas raised the price of imported white rice by 36% on 1 September 2023.

title.ms: Minyak masak botol melonjak apabila subsidinya tamat
title.en: Bottled cooking oil jumped when its subsidy ended

text.ms: Sebotol 2kg minyak masak Cap Buruh berharga {price:2022-06} pada Jun 2022. Subsidi minyak masak botol tamat pada 1 Julai 2022, dan harganya menjadi {price:2022-07} pada Jul 2022 sebelum turun kepada {price:2022-10} pada Okt 2022.
text.en: A 2kg bottle of Cap Buruh cooking oil cost {price:2022-06} in Jun 2022. The subsidy for bottled cooking oil ended on 1 July 2022, and the price was {price:2022-07} in Jul 2022 before easing to {price:2022-10} by Oct 2022.
